title: Dry‑run Rehearsal Scheduler with Fast‑Bisect Rollback Advisory and A/B Cohort Manager
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: teams running staged model promotes asked for a safer, low-friction way to rehearse rollouts and quickly diagnose regressions during canary/A-B promotions. This PR introduces a dry-run rehearsal scheduler that runs synthetic shadow traffic against candidate model versions, and a fast-bisect rollback advisor that narrows suspected regression commits when a telemetric gate trips. It also adds a lightweight A/B Cohort Manager to coordinate cohort assignment and persist experiment metadata. Design summary: 1) Rehearsal Scheduler: schedules 'dry-run' rehearsals using a synthetic traffic harness that mimics production request distributions but isolates KV cache/state; supports timeboxed windows and quota-based parallelism. 2) Fast‑Bisect Advisor: when an SLO gate (latency/error/regression) fires during a staged rollout, the advisor runs a targeted binary search across recent model deltas using replayed inputs captured by the rehearsal harness and returns a ranked list of suspect model diffs with confidence scores. 3) A/B Cohort Manager: deterministic assignment with sticky keys, cohort metadata stored in rollout store, and APIs for console to visualize cohorts and slice-specific metrics. Motivation: customers need predictable rollouts that are low-cost to validate and fast to remediate; current manual bisect workflows are slow and error-prone. This unifies dry validation, proactive bisection, and cohort coordination into the rollout runtime. Checklist: [x] Scheduler scaffold and API endpoints added; [x] rehearsal executor and synthetic harness; [x] fast-bisect algorithm + replay runner; [x] cohort assignment API + basic console hooks; [x] unit + integration tests; [x] docs and runbook. Commits summary: "scaffold: rehearsal scheduler and API"; "executor: synthetic harness and replay capture"; "advisor: fast-bisect core loop and confidence scoring"; "cohort: manager APIs and console wiring"; "tests: integration flow and smoke scripts"; "docs: dry-run runbook and troubleshooting". Files changed (high-level): rollout/scheduler/scheduler.go (orchestration loop and policy), rollout/rehearsal/executor.py (rehearsal harness & replay capture), rollout/advisors/fast_bisect.go (bisect runtime), rollout/cohorts/manager.ts (cohort assignment + store), console/src/components/abCohortView.tsx (visualization), telemetry/metrics/rollout_metrics.md (new metrics), docs/runbooks/dryrun-rehearsal.md, tests/integration/test_rehearsal_flow.yaml, ci/workflows/rehearsal-integration.yml, tools/replay/replay_runner.py. Testing: added unit tests covering scheduler policy transitions, integration suite that spins up a rehearsal sandbox with synthetic traffic and verifies metrics invariants, recorded a small e2e run against a staging model, and ran canary smoke with deterministic cohorts. CI: full integration matrix passes; we temporarily quarantined a flaky test run in replay_runner and hardened timeouts. Safety & rollback: rehearsals run in isolated sandboxes by default and cannot write to production KV; fast-bisect is read-only for production artifacts and only suggests candidate rollbacks — automated rollback requires an opt-in policy under rollout config (default: manual approval). Rollout plan: staged rollout in three phases — dry-run rehearsals for 48h against 5% shadow traffic, canary promotion with cohorted A/B at 1%->10%->50%, fast-bisect enabled in advisory mode for first two phases, and auto-rollback gated behind explicit enterprise policy. Docs & runbooks: docs/runbooks/dryrun-rehearsal.md and console help entries added with troubleshooting steps and example Linear links and escalation paths. Related: ENG-1976 (rehearsal scheduler), ENG-2020 (bisect advisor); SUP-4532 (customer incident that motivated fast-bisect). Migration notes: rollout configs accept new fields rehearsal.window/rehearsal.quota/fast_bisect.enabled and cohort.assignment.strategy; defaults are backward-compatible. Performance: rehearsal harness uses sampled request distributions and replay sampling to keep cost under 15% of a full traffic mirror; fast-bisect runs prioritized delta searches to limit compute (configurable budget). Release notes summary: New: dry-run rehearsal scheduler, fast-bisect rollback advisor (advisory by default), A/B Cohort Manager and console hooks; Improvements: faster incident triage for canaries and reduced manual bisect time. Merge: merged via squash on 2026-02-24 after CI green and 2 approvals.
